out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the hand sink located next to the 3-vat sink in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO RESTOCK THE PAPER TOWELS.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at the EMPLOYEE RESTROOM HAND SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO PROVIDE A HAND WASHING SIGN.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed boxes of single service items such as paper trays stored in direct contact with the floor in the dry storage closet.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO MOVE THE BOXES TO THE SHELVING UNITS OR DUNNAGE RACKS.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the employee restroom stall.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO PROVIDE A COVERED TRASH CAN. HERNDON INTERMEDIATE SCHOOL (Inspection Date: 11/18/2024) Page 2 of 3
